FIRST AMENDMENT TO VENDOR SERVICES AGREEMENT

This First Amendment (the "Amendment") is entered into between Acme
Fulfillment Solutions LLC ("Vendor") and Beta Retail Client Inc. ("Client"),
and hereby amends the Vendor Services Agreement effective January 15, 2026
(the "Agreement").

Section 1. Amended Payment Terms.
Section 1 of the Agreement is hereby amended in its entirety. Payment terms
are now net 45 days from the date of invoice, superseding the thirty (30)
day term originally stated in the Agreement.

Section 2. No Other Changes.
Except as expressly amended herein, all other terms and conditions of the
Agreement, including termination notice, contract value, indemnification
cap, and governing law, remain in full force and effect and are unchanged
by this Amendment.
